mapper.select: SELECT id, rule_code, rule_name, threshold_value, enabled, remark, create_time, update_time FROM dms_finance_risk_rule ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_finance_risk_rule (rule_code, rule_name, threshold_value, enabled, remark) VALUES (#{ruleCode}, #{ruleName}, #{thresholdValue}, #{enabled}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_finance_risk_rule SET rule_name = #{ruleName}, threshold_value = #{thresholdValue}, enabled = #{enabled}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE rule_code = #{ruleCode}
